required_repairs_before_preregistration: Precisely define rollback semantics and document limitations of rollback emulation; include clear examples distinguishing reversible vs irreversible states.
Design and document anti-overfitting measures (hidden test split, challenge/evaluation protocol) and publish an evaluation harness with seed-controlled reruns and result verification.
Increase or justify topology and intent diversity; where possible include at least one realistic publicly sourced topology/intent trace and document representativeness rationale.
Formally specify scoring protocols (verifier-pass, action-impact, rollback-penalty-adjusted), enumerate edge cases, provide reference implementations, and publish artifact hashes for reproducibility.
